versions.content: After reception of each frame of a TP message (SF, FF and CF), the LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTpCopyRxData with a PduInfo pointer containing received data (SduDataPtr) and data length (SduLength). The data length is 5 bytes (including SID) for FF, up to 6 bytes for SF and 6 bytes for CF (or less in case of the last CF).
